Best-product 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Instantly recommends top, value, and budget products in any category based on expert reviews.
- Supports US, UK, and major EU regions with region-specific sources and retailer checks.
- Outputs concise summaries and Google search links for all picks—no direct retailer links.
- Auto-detects region based on command (with override) and caches results for 6 hours.
- Prioritizes security: no personal data sent, only search queries to Brave Search API.
